note: Glue submodule of ebt_core. Provides one admin form route ebt_core_remove_helper.ebt_remove_helper at /admin/structure/block/remove-ebt-blocks (local task 'Remove All EBT Blocks', permission administer site configuration). EbtRemoveHelperForm offers two operations: remove_all_ebt_blocks (Batch-deletes all block_content of ebt_-prefixed bundles) and remove_ebt_settings_field_storage (deletes field_ebt_settings storage only when no ebt_ block types remain). EBT content is identified by the ebt_ bundle machine-name prefix. No config/permissions/Drush/plugins of its own. As a glue module: 3 easy / 1 medium / 1 hard. medium introspects which block_content types are EBT-prefixed on the live site. hard: the agent removes the EBT block(s) of a specific namespaced EBT type (the module's core purpose), verified against live block_content. Cases are scoped to a dedicated ebt_-prefixed block type so no other agents' content is touched.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal ebt_core_remove_helper module, at what admin path is its 'Remove EBT Blocks' form, and what does the form let you do?
evals.expected_output: The form is at /admin/structure/block/remove-ebt-blocks (route ebt_core_remove_helper.ebt_remove_helper, a local task 'Remove All EBT Blocks'). It offers two operations: Remove All EBT Blocks and Remove EBT Settings Field Storage.

evals.prompt: What are the two operations offered by the ebt_core_remove_helper form in Drupal, and what does each do?
evals.expected_output: 1) Remove All EBT Blocks — batch-deletes every block_content of ebt_-prefixed bundles. 2) Remove EBT Settings Field Storage — deletes the field_ebt_settings field storage, but only when no ebt_ block types remain.

evals.prompt: How does the Drupal ebt_core_remove_helper module decide which blocks/block types count as 'EBT' ones to remove?
evals.expected_output: It treats any block_content type whose machine name starts with the ebt_ prefix as an EBT block type (getAllEbtBlockTypes filters block_content_type storage by that prefix), and removes block_content entities of those bundles.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the ebt_core_remove_helper module considers a block content type to be an 'EBT' type by its machine-name prefix. Inspect the live site and give the machine name of the EBT-prefixed block content type that currently exists.
evals.expected_output: The EBT-prefixed block content type is ebt_rhprobe (a block_content_type whose id starts with ebt_), discoverable by listing block_content_type entities and filtering for the ebt_ prefix.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is an EBT block content type 'ebt_rhtask' with one block_content entity of that type. Following what the ebt_core_remove_helper module does, remove all EBT blocks of type ebt_rhtask from the site (delete the block_content entities of that bundle). Apply the change to the live site. Do not remove blocks of any other type.
evals.expected_output: No block_content entity of type ebt_rhtask remains (entityQuery block_content, condition type=ebt_rhtask, returns 0). E.g. load the ebt_rhtask block_content entities and delete them, as the Remove All EBT Blocks operation does.
